What's new in ShawNotch 1.8.2

  • Dragging the playback line moves the song in Spotify again. Recent versions of Spotify stopped listening to macOS, so ShawNotch now asks Spotify itself, with the same permission it already uses for shuffle and repeat.
  • The Black notch has Liquid Glass's rounder corners too, open and closed.
  • The Mirror's preview follows the notch's curve, with an even edge all round it.
